description: The Pro Trend Line Chart renders time-phased planned and actual data as configurable S-curves with a color-coded variance band — green where performance exceeds plan, red where it falls short. It includes forecast projection, anomaly detection, reference lines, trend overlays, conditional formatting, and a slide-out Analysis Panel showing live averages, totals, variance %, and achievement rate. All elements respond dynamically to cross-visual filtering from slicers, tables, and matrices. Fully configurable through Power BI's Format pane with no code required.
